source_label: Sample release scenario (config/workflow_stages.json): illustrative stage progress, not live workflow state.

mode_descriptions.agentic: Agents plan and execute; gates check evidence before the stage can close.
mode_descriptions.deterministic: Scripts run fixed commands; no agent may improvise or skip a step.

stages.title: Spec
stages.summary: Turn the request into a testable spec linked to an outcome and goal.
entry_gates: Request is linked to an Outcome and Goal in the task backend
No open S1 task exists for the same goal
exit_gates: SPEC.md lists acceptance criteria and a test plan
core-coordinator approval is captured as a signed receipt

stages.title: Code
stages.summary: Builders implement the spec in disjoint file leases.
entry_gates: Each builder holds a disjoint file lease
exit_gates: All builders report done with commit SHAs

stages.title: Test
stages.summary: Prove the change with happy-path, edge-case, and chaos tests plus a browser sweep.
exit_gates: Playwright sweep shows 0 console errors and 0 anomaly strings

stages.title: Review
stages.summary: Three-model council reviews the diff; reviewers never review their own code.
entry_gates: S3 evidence is attached to the task
exit_gates: 3 of 3 council approvals with reviewer different from builder

stages.title: Release gate
stages.summary: Fixed checks decide whether the release may ship.
entry_gates: S4 council decision is 3 of 3 approve
exit_gates: DP-001 guard policy is active and its shadow replay gate is PASS
Human release approval is captured as a signed receipt

stages.title: Deploy and close
stages.summary: Ship behind IAP, smoke-test, and close the task with evidence.
entry_gates: WORKFLOW_STAGE=S6_DEPLOY_CLOSE is set for the guard
exit_gates: New revision serves 100% of traffic behind IAP
scripts/s6_rollback.py dry-run finds a previous revision
